properties.name: MEASURED on 0.77.0: find_tools ranks get_node 8th for "read one node by id with its properties and edges" (below create_edges, draw_edges, scan_nodes, add_actor, describe_schema, provides and delete_node), and so leaves it out of the default 5. It ranks get_node 1st for "read one node by id", "fetch a node by id" and "pull up the full record for a requirement". The ranking is honest. The miss is a symptom of having no edge reader, not a find_tools defect
properties.statement:
FROM THE 2026-10-02 TRIAGE (agent B), tool friction "find_tools for 'read one node by id with its properties and edges' does not return get_node" in art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02. Root-cause skill fetched fresh.

MEASURED, by `--call find_tools` with limit 8 and then 200, on a scratch import of main's export. Full table in /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-B/find_tools_ranking.txt.

| Query | get_node rank |
|---|---|
| "read one node by id with its properties and edges" | 8 (scores: create_edges 12.84 … get_node 8.5) |
| "read one node by id" | 1 |
| "fetch a node by id" | 1 |
| "pull up the full record for a requirement" | 1 |
| "show a node's neighbours" | 1 (propagate_from 5) |
| "get a node and its edges" | 2 |
| "list the edges of a node" | 9 |
| "which nodes link to this one" | 142 |

CAUSE: find_tools is BM25-weighted over name, description and parameter names (query.rs:817). "edges" is a high-weight term on the edge writers' names and descriptions. get_node's description correctly does not mention edges, because it returns none. A query asking for a node WITH its edges describes a tool that does not exist (fact:root-cause-no-served-read-returns-one-nodes-edges-and-the-nearest-is-an-impact-walk-2026-10-02), and find_tools ranked what exists.

THE REPORT'S CONCLUSION, PARTLY OVERTURNED: the observation is exact, but find_tools is not at fault. A weight change that lifted get_node here would send the agent to a tool that does not answer the "and edges" half.

Not established: whether the reporter's agent would have tried a shorter query. The report does not say.
